# Vendored JavaScript

`jsqr.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from jsQR **1.4.0**.

- Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/jsqr/-/jsqr-1.4.0.tgz
- License: Apache-2.0, preserved in `jsqr.LICENSE`.
- Bundle SHA-256: `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`

The npm package SHA-512 integrity was verified before copying the bundle.
Loaded locally on QR upload; no runtime CDN dependency.
